evidence: Carries the IPC label and implements Cap'n Proto serialization and proxy wrappers for interfaces::Chain and interfaces::Handler under src/ipc/.
rationale: Exposing interfaces::Chain over IPC is a prerequisite for separating the wallet into its own process in #10102. The PR description notes that this change 'allows the wallet code to run in a separate process and use the Chain interface,' unblocking foundational multiprocess work and downstream external clients.
